lines.en: I crawl slowly through the Sticky Marshes.
The mire sucks at my feet.
Every step takes a hard pull.
I leave a row of mud pits.
This marsh keeps bubbling.
I walk along a fallen log.
Mud water reaches my knees.
I go around the reeds.
Mud is plastered on my shell.
Marsh mud leaves a pit every step.
The wind carries rot.

lines.zh: 我踩着浮萍，往沼泽深处走。
lines.en: Treading the duckweed, I head deeper into the marsh.
I slide my body over the mud.
I broke through a patch of soft ground.
I pull one leg out of the mud.
I move close to the water's surface.
I soak in the mud without moving.
Bubbles rise beside me.
This is the coolest spot.
I slowly draw my legs in.
No one notices me in the marsh.
Half my body is buried in mud.
An oily sheen lies on the water.
I listen to the insects.
The mire here is soft.
It's so comfortable I don't want to move.
Soak a little longer.
I rest my head on the mud.
You stepped into my marsh mud.
This marsh is hard to cross.
I've been here a while.
Your boots must be sinking.
The mud grips things tight.
Stand still. Don't thrash.

lines.zh: 复眼里有千百个小你，动一下都清楚。
lines.en: A thousand tiny yous fill my compound eyes; every move shows.
Dry things aren't welcome here.
Either way you go is the same.
This marsh has no edge.
Mud splashed into my eyes.
I rolled over in the mud.
A layer of mud came off my shell.

lines.zh: 黏沼泽的泥，黏住你的脚。
lines.en: Sticky marsh mud holds your feet.

lines.zh: 甲壳被敲裂，我沉进泥水。
lines.en: My shell splits; I sink into the muddy water.
The mud blocked half of it.
Your club made the mud jump.
I sink into the mud and shift away.
I'm still in the mud.
That one sank into the mud.

lines.zh: 你手里那点甜味，我触角抖了。
lines.en: That sweetness in your hand makes my antennae twitch.
Put it down. I'll look myself.
I can eat mud.
In the mire I eat anything.
That smells sweet.
Half an inch lower and I can reach.

lines.zh: 触角在你手边扫了两下。
lines.en: My antennae sweep your hand twice.
That thing in your hand has an odd color.

lines.zh: 泥上的味道混在一起了。
lines.en: The smells on the mud have merged.

lines.zh: 我探出长颈，凑近你掌心。
lines.en: I stretch my long neck toward your palm.
You hit me in the mire.
We both sank into the mud.
My shell stuck to your leg.
Don't push. It only sinks deeper.
I keep my footing in the sticky marsh better than you.
The mud pulled us a little apart.
Sticky marsh mud holds me.
I surface from the mud.
The ground here was already soft.
Just pull yourself out.
There are others in the marsh.
Such things suit the water better.

lines.zh: 触角碰一碰，就都明白了。
lines.en: A touch of antennae and we understand.
Sound doesn't carry far in mud.
She's in the mud below me.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我正把卵埋进泥。
lines.en: Stay back. I'm burying eggs in the mud.
The mud here swallows you.
We're only staying here.
Don't stir up the mud.
It won't take long.
It sank into the mud.
I had to paw twice to find it.
It's something hard.

lines.zh: 泥水里的东西，我用颚夹起。
lines.en: I lift the thing from the mud with my mandibles.
The mud has coated it.
I tuck it under my shell.
Too heavy. It's sinking.
Forget it.
It's invisible in the mud.
I'll remember this spot.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥泡破开，我探出前肢。
lines.en: A mud bubble pops and I push out my forelimb.
Not a ripple.
I raise my head.
I lift my head out of the mud.
This marsh is mine.
The scent is clear now.
I drag myself over.
The mud will help me.
It can't run fast.
No one can stand straight here.
I sink myself into the mud.
It's moving slowly.

lines.zh: 泥浆顺着我的壳往下流。
lines.en: Mire runs down my shell.
I've fixed on its direction.
I follow low over the mud.
Every step of its sinks deep.
I'm a little lighter than it.
The mud slows it down.

lines.zh: 我贴着芦苇根，摸到你的侧后。
lines.en: Hugging the reed roots, I work around your flank.
The water is deep here.

lines.zh: 我认得每一条安全的路。
lines.en: I know every safe path.
It stepped wrong.

lines.zh: 六条腿拨开烂泥，我追上来。
lines.en: Six legs churn the muck as I close in.
Dead water ahead.
It'll get stuck.
Almost there.
The path under the mud is shorter.
I'll come from behind it.
I pounced on it.
We rolled into the mud.
My mouthparts bit into its leg.
It can't pull free of the mud.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的靴，往泥里拽。
lines.en: I bite your boot and haul it into the mud.
It choked on muddy water.
I press down again.
Its hand grabbed nothing.
The mud has closed over you.
I let go, and let it sink.
I rise from under the mud.
A bubble turned over on the surface.
The marsh is where I usually stay.
This mud is warm.
Mud slides off my back.
I glance at the bank.
Only me and the reeds here.
You came at a good time.
I just woke up.
The mist hides everything far off.

lines.zh: 火烧在湿泥上，冒起白烟。
lines.en: Fire on wet mud raised white smoke.

lines.zh: 我摔进泥里，一点也不疼。
lines.en: I fell into the mud. Didn't hurt at all.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进来，我挣得很急。
lines.en: Muddy water poured in and I thrashed.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥浆掀起来一大片。
lines.en: The blast threw up a sheet of mire.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进泥里，扎到我的壳。
lines.en: An arrow came through the mud and hit my shell.

lines.zh: 一道光打过来，我的壳发烫。
lines.en: A flash came and my shell grew hot.
Little to eat in the mud.

lines.zh: 雷落在沼泽上，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the marsh and numbed me.

lines.zh: 这里没有泥，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No mud here. I can't hold on.
